newsitem.title: UK: B.Gas unit to lose "golden share' - paper.
newsitem.headline: B.Gas unit to lose "golden share' - paper.

text.p: Centrica, the gas sales and trading firm to be formed out of the British Gas demerger, is to lose its "golden share" protection from takeover when it is spun off from the rest of the group, the Observer newspaper reported.

The government has held a golden share, allowing it to block a bid, since the gas industry was privatised a decade ago. Its loss will heighten speculation that Centrica will be vulnerable to predators keen to gain access to its Morecambe Bay gas field, the newspaper said.
British gas shareholders will vote on the planned demerger on February 12.
No one at the company could be reached for comment.
